description: Moves the toolhead in a straight line to the given position, optionally extruding while it goes.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: Target position on the X axis.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: Target position on the Y axis.

parameters.name: Z
parameters.description: Target position on the Z axis.

parameters.name: E
parameters.description: Amount of filament to push or pull over the move.

parameters.name: F
parameters.description: Feed rate for this move, in millimetres per minute.

description: Sets the hotend target temperature and returns at once without waiting for it to be reached.

parameters.name: S
parameters.description: Target temperature in degrees Celsius; 0 switches the heater off.

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Which tool or extruder to heat, when there is more than one.
